suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as bleeding mediated disease complication. Require documented uterine fibroids with clinically relevant abnormal/heavy uterine bleeding and separately documented iron deficiency and/or anemia. Do not infer anemia from asymptomatic fibroids. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-11 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Among women undergoing laparoscopic myomectomy for symptomatic leiomyomas, 25.6% had unexpected histologically confirmed endometriosis, supporting clinically relevant co-occurrence. Treat strictly as co-occurrence/association and screening relevance, not fibroids causing endometriosis. Preserve shared estrogen-related biology, age, infertility/nulliparity, referral and surgical-selection bias, and other endometriosis risk factors. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
